execution.raw_text:
{
  "up": "Select molecule_chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units
Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno
Join assays on assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid
Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Filter activities.bao_endpoint = 'EC50'
Filter activities.standard_type = 'EC50'
Filter activities.standard_value < 100
Filter activities.standard_units = 'nM'
Filter activities.standard_relation = '='
Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL
Filter activities.standard_units IS NOT NULL
Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units
Limit 500"
}
